  o.o_orderpriority,
  (COUNT(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) AS return_rate

  orders o
  JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
WHERE
  o.o_orderdate >= '1993-01-01'

GROUP BY
  o.o_orderpriority
ORDER BY
  o.o_orderpriority

WITH pair_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    c.c_custkey,
    p.p_partkey
  FROM customer c
  JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
  JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
  JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
),
repeat_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    pc1.c_custkey,
    pc1.p_partkey
  FROM pair_counts pc1
  WHERE pc1.c_custkey IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT pc2.c_custkey
    FROM pair_counts pc2
    WHERE pc2.c_custkey = pc1.c_custkey
    AND pc2.p_partkey IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT pc3.p_partkey
      FROM pair_counts pc3
      WHERE pc3.p_partkey = pc1.p_partkey
    )
  )
)
SELECT 
  c.c_mktsegment,

SELECT
    n.n_name AS n_name,
    COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count
FROM
    nation n
LEFT JOIN
    customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey AND c.c_mktsegment = 'MACHINERY'
LEFT JOIN
    orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey AND o.o_orderdate >= '1996-03-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1996-04-01'
GROUP BY
    n.n_name
ORDER BY
    order_count DESC,
    n.n_name

SELECT
    n.n_name,
    COUNT(*) AS line_count,
    (100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)) AS late_pct
FROM
    region r
    JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey
    JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
    JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
WHERE
    r.r_name = 'AMERICA'
    AND l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01'
    AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-01-01'
GROUP BY
    n.n_name
ORDER BY
    late_pct DESC

GROUP BY

    COUNT(*) AS line_count,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS late_pct
FROM
    region r

    nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey

    supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
